WRMI Radio Miami International FAQ

What frequency is WRMI Radio Miami International on?
In the A-26 season WRMI Radio Miami International is scheduled on 10 shortwave frequencies, including 5010, 5050, 5800, 5850, 5950, 9395 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9395 kHz (24 hours a day). For Europe: 9955 kHz (10 pm – 3 am UTC+1).

Can I hear WRMI Radio Miami International in the USA?
Yes. WRMI Radio Miami International is beamed at North America this season on 5010, 5050, 5850, 5950, 9395 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 9395 kHz (24 hours a day).

Does WRMI Radio Miami International broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 5010 kHz at 01:00–02:00 UTC to Caribbean; 5010 kHz at 23:00–24h UTC to Caribbean; 5050 kHz at 00:00–04:00 UTC to Central America; 5800 kHz at 02:00–04:00 UTC to LAm; 5850 kHz at 01:00–13:00 UTC to W. North America; plus 9 more.

Is WRMI Radio Miami International on the air right now?
As of Friday, September 25, 2026, 10:11 UTC, WRMI Radio Miami International is scheduled to be broadcasting on 5850 kHz to W. North America. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
